name: matlab-compute-gnss-position
description: Computes multi-constellation Global Positioning System (GPS) or Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) positions from RINEX v3 data using rinexread, gnssmeasurements, receiverposition, and gnssoptions. Filters by constellation, elevation mask, C/N0, and observation code. Reports DOP, scatter RMS, and satellite count. Use when processing GNSS data, computing positions from RINEX files, analyzing accuracy, comparing constellations, or evaluating satellite geometry. Do NOT use for carrier-phase RTK/PPP, IMU fusion, orbit propagation, NMEA streaming, or RINEX v4.
